turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. I have until 4:40, so tell me why my son has a zero.
Be honest. On a scale of one to ten, how am I doing in this meeting?
I'm not grading you, Hale. Why does my son have a zero?
And what's one thing I could do better?
That's your job, Hale, not mine. I'm here for Owen, and I'm still waiting to hear who decided on the zero.
